name: Blueleaf Tubers
summary: Mebok Mizzyrix sends trained gophers into Razorfen Kraul to find Blueleaf Tubers. The Ratchet merchant seeks the buried delicacy for trade.

sections.title: A Prized Subterranean Delicacy
sections.body: In the southern Barrens, Blueleaf Tubers lie deep beneath the roots of Razorfen Kraul. Their rarity makes them a delicacy prized across the world. They grow far from open fields and ordinary wild groves, so foragers must search underground.

sections.title: Mizzyrix's Ingenuity
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix, a merchant in Ratchet, has devised a way to find buried tubers. He trains snufflenose gophers to catch a tuber's scent from fifty paces away. Foragers receive a command stick, a ventilated crate, and an instruction manual to guide the creatures through quilboar territory.

sections.title: Harvesting in the Thorns
sections.body: The harvest lies in the lands of the hostile Death's Head quilboar tribe. In the Kraul, you must guard your trained gopher from feral beasts and thorny briars, then command it to dig up the buried bulbs. The tubers go back to Ratchet, where Mizzyrix's foreign buyers await.

faq.q: What are Blueleaf Tubers used for?
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers are a rare culinary delicacy prized around the world. Wealthy buyers pay well for fresh tubers, making them profitable trade goods for goblins like Mebok Mizzyrix.
Blueleaf Tubers lie beneath the earth and thorny roots of the southern Barrens, inside the quilboar stronghold of Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Why do you need a Snufflenose Gopher to find them?
faq.answer: The tubers lie underground, beyond ordinary sight. A snufflenose gopher can smell them from up to fifty paces away and dig them out.
Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin merchant based in Ratchet, a neutral port town in the Barrens. He trains native wildlife and acquires exotic goods for foreign trade.

faq.q: What equipment does Mizzyrix provide for the job?
faq.answer: Mizzyrix provides a Crate with Holes holding a trained gopher, a Snufflenose Command Stick to direct its digging, and a Snufflenose Owner's Manual explaining how to handle the beast.

faq.q: Why can't Mebok gather the tubers himself?
faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul is guarded by aggressive quilboar tribes, thorny vines, and dangerous creatures beneath the earth. Mizzyrix sends others into the barrows rather than risk going himself.

angles.text: As a cook, you know Blueleaf Tubers rank among Azeroth's rarest delicacies. Elite buyers prize their earthy flavor.
As a herbalist, you know Blueleaf Tubers grow underground among Razorfen's briar roots, away from sunlight.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use Mizzyrix's trade contract in neutral Ratchet to enter territory near Horde lands.
As a Horde warrior defending the Barrens from quilboar incursions, you can earn coin by guiding Mizzyrix's trained gophers through the Kraul.
